access_logs.list.description: List access logs page by page: every operation call of the caller’s side with its result, duration and client; filter by time range, trace, user, session, operation, result and status code. Requires auditing.access-logs.read.
access_logs.get.description: Get an access log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.access-logs.read.
exception_logs.list.description: List exception logs page by page: unhandled exceptions of the caller’s side with type, message and location. Requires auditing.exception-logs.read.
exception_logs.get.description: Get an exception log of the caller’s side, including the full stack trace. Requires auditing.exception-logs.read.
login_logs.list.description: List sign-in logs page by page: sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation and password change events of the caller’s side, successful or not. Requires auditing.login-logs.read.
login_logs.get.description: Get a sign-in log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.login-logs.read.
operation_logs.list.description: List operation logs page by page: audited business operations of the caller’s side with their results and durations. Requires auditing.operation-logs.read.
operation_logs.get.description: Get an operation log of the caller’s side, including its details. Requires auditing.operation-logs.read.
diff_logs.list.description: List data change logs page by page: entity inserts, updates and deletes of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.diff-logs.read.
diff_logs.get.description: Get a data change log of the caller’s side with field-level before and after values. Requires auditing.diff-logs.read.
permission_change_logs.list.description: List permission change logs page by page: grants, revocations, role membership, data scope and edition changes of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.permission-change-logs.read.
permission_change_logs.get.description: Get a permission change log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.permission-change-logs.read.
condition_hits.list.description: List condition hits page by page: access policy and permission condition hits of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.condition-hits.read.
condition_hits.get.description: Get a condition hit of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.condition-hits.read.
open_api_logs.list.description: List open API logs page by page: signed open API calls of the caller’s side with their signature checks. Requires auditing.open-api-logs.read.
open_api_logs.get.description: Get an open API log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.open-api-logs.read.
traces.timeline.description: Aggregate the logs of the caller’s side by trace, user, session or client address into one timeline, oldest first, with counts per log type. Requires auditing.traces.read.

my_login_logs.list.description: List your own sign-in logs page by page (sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation, password change and more, successful or not), newest first, up to 50 per page. Requires sign-in only.
my_activity.summary.description: Your activity: sign-ins, accesses and operations today, this week and this month, the latest of each, and daily operations and accesses over the last 371 days, split by the requested time zone. Requires sign-in only.
auditing.time_zone.invalid: The time zone '{timeZone}' is not valid.
